# Link (`link`)

Inline text link: accent, muted or inherit.

Group: Actions. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/actions';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createLink` (types in `dist/web/actions/link.d.ts`): `.mh-link--accent | --muted | --inherit` (`--subtle`: underline on hover): an inline text link. Parts `__text` (carries the underline, so icons aren't underlined) and `__external`. A link with no `href` renders a `<button>`.

```ts
export function createLink(options: LinkOptions): LinkHandle;

export interface LinkOptions {
  text: string;
  /** Without an `href` the link is a `<button>` (an action styled as a link). */
  href?: string;
  tone?: LinkTone;
  underline?: LinkUnderline;
  /** Leading icon. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Opens in a new tab (`target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`), with an icon and a spoken hint. */
  external?: boolean;
  /** The spoken hint of an external link; default "opens in a new tab". */
  newTabLabel?: string;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface LinkHandle {
  el: HTMLAnchorElement | HTMLButtonElement;
  setText(text: string): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createLink } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const help = createLink({ text: 'how sensors report', href: 'https://example.com/sensors', external: true });

// Without an href the link renders a button: an action that looks like a link.
const more = createLink({
  text: 'Show three more devices',
  onClick: () => more.setText('All devices shown'),
});

const note = document.createElement('p');
note.append('The hallway sensor reports every five minutes. Read ', help.el, '. ', more.el);

document.body.append(note);
```

## React API

`Link` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createLink`: an `<a>` with an `href`, else a `<button>`.

```ts
export function Link(props: LinkProps);

export type LinkProps = LinkOwnProps &
  (({ href: string } & Omit<AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>, 'href' | 'children'>) | ({ href?: undefined } & Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'children'>));
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function LinkExample() {
  const [showAll, setShowAll] = useState(false);
  return (
    <p>
      The hallway sensor reports every five minutes. Read{' '}
      <Link href="https://example.com/sensors" external>
        how sensors report
      </Link>
      .{' '}
      {/* Without an href the link renders a button: an action that looks like a link. */}
      <Link onClick={() => setShowAll(true)}>
        {showAll ? 'All devices shown' : 'Show three more devices'}
      </Link>
    </p>
  );
}
```
